items.name: Weeknight Carrot Mung Rice
steps: Measure 850 ml (about 3 1/2 cups) water for Weeknight Carrot Mung Rice; bring it to a full boil, then keep it covered and hot for the additions below.

Toast cumin in ghee and coat the rice and mung. Give the spices about 30 seconds before adding the larger pieces, then continue over medium-low heat for 2–3 minutes, moving the pan often, until the raw aroma is gone.

Add carrot and hot water, then cover the boiling pot. Bring the pot to a brisk simmer over medium-high heat for 4–6 minutes, then cover as bubbles reach the center and continue with the timed cook below.
Cook until soft, season, and rest the dinner briefly. Maintain low heat for 16–18 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until a thin knife slides through the largest piece without resistance.
At minute 14, scrape the base with a flat spoon and rotate the pot; add 30 ml hot water only if the grains begin to catch.
Fluff or stir Weeknight Carrot Mung Rice once after its off-heat rest, check the final consistency, and serve it warm without prolonged holding.

items.name: Weeknight Pumpkin Masoor Rice
steps: For Weeknight Pumpkin Masoor Rice, heat 850 ml (about 3 1/2 cups) water until vigorously boiling, then lower it to a bare simmer beside the main pot for measured additions.
Stir the rice and red lentils through warm ghee and coriander. Keep the pan over steady low heat for 2–3 minutes after the final addition, folding from the bottom so the main pieces remain intact.
Tip in the pumpkin and hot water and lower the heat. Work over moderate heat for 11–13 minutes; continue once a thin knife slides through the largest piece without resistance.
Fold the softened cubes through the grains and season. Leave the pan off the flame for 4 minutes, then taste and correct the final balance before serving at the stated temperature.
Rest Weeknight Pumpkin Masoor Rice 5 minutes covered off the burner; check the final consistency and serve it warm without prolonged holding.

Warm cumin in ghee and stir through the rice. Give the spices about 30 seconds before adding the larger pieces, then continue over moderate heat for 3–4 minutes, moving the pan often, until the raw aroma is gone.
Add beans and water and cook almost to tenderness. Maintain medium-low heat for 6–8 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until a knife tip enters the thickest stem with only slight resistance.
Nestle the paneer among the beans, finish the steaming, and add salt. Leave the pan off the flame for 6 minutes, then taste and correct the final balance before serving at the stated temperature.
Rest Weeknight Green Bean Paneer Rice 6 minutes covered off the burner; check the final consistency and serve it warm without prolonged holding.
items.guidance: Weeknight Green Bean Paneer Rice is a practical one-pot dinner designed to finish within thirty minutes Vata: serve it moist and warm with the stated fat. Pitta: keep the seasoning mild and reduce tomato where present. Kapha: use a smaller grain portion and emphasize vegetables.

items.name: Weeknight Fennel Tofu Millet

ingredients.name: Firm tofu, drained and cut into cubes

steps: Measure 850 ml (about 3 1/2 cups) water for Weeknight Fennel Tofu Millet; bring it to a full boil, then keep it covered and hot for the additions below.
For Weeknight Fennel Tofu Millet, cover the proso millet with at least three times its volume of cool water and soak for 20 minutes; drain for 2 minutes before the first heated step.
Soften fennel bulb and seeds in olive oil. Work over medium-low heat for 6–8 minutes; continue once a grain pressed between two fingers has no chalky center.

Add millet and water and cover until nearly cooked. Keep the pot covered over gentle medium heat for 12–14 minutes; check once at the midpoint and continue until a grain pressed between two fingers has no chalky center.
Fold in tofu for the final steaming and season. Leave the pan off the flame for 5 minutes, then taste and correct the final balance before serving at the stated temperature.
Rest Weeknight Fennel Tofu Millet 4 minutes covered off the burner; check the final consistency and serve it warm without prolonged holding.

items.name: Weeknight Spinach Paneer Rice
steps: Measure 850 ml (about 3 1/2 cups) water for Weeknight Spinach Paneer Rice; bring it to a full boil, then keep it covered and hot for the additions below.
Cook rice with fennel until the grains are nearly tender. Maintain medium-low heat for 10–12 minutes, stirring every 3 minutes, until a grain pressed between two fingers has no chalky center.

Layer spinach and paneer over the surface and cover. Keep the pot covered over gentle medium heat for 4–6 minutes; check once at the midpoint and continue until the leaves wilt but still retain their color.
Fold the wilted greens through and season the dinner. Leave the pan off the flame for 4 minutes, then taste and correct the final balance before serving at the stated temperature.
Rest Weeknight Spinach Paneer Rice 6 minutes covered off the burner; check the final consistency and serve it warm without prolonged holding.
